# Fintech Disruption: Traditional Banking vs Digital Finance (2015–2024)

## Overview
Four datasets tracking the global shift from traditional banking to fintech-driven digital finance across four regions (North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America) over a ten-year period from 2015 to 2024.

## Data Source

### digital_payment_penetration
Annual digital payment adoption rate as a percentage of the adult population. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `penetration_pct` (float, 18.3–91.2%). Represents share of adults who made at least one digital payment transaction in the year.

### traditional_bank_branches
Total number of physical bank branch locations in thousands. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `branches_k` (float, 58.6–315.8 thousand). Covers commercial and retail bank branches.

### neobank_users
Cumulative registered users of digital-only banks (neobanks) in millions. Fields: `year` (integer, 2016–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `users_m` (float, 0.8–498.3 million). Starts from 2016 when neobanks began gaining traction.

### digital_bank_licenses
Cumulative count of full digital banking licenses approved by national regulators. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `cumulative_licenses` (integer, 0–85).

## Data Notes
- All figures are estimated composites across countries within each region
- Digital payment penetration includes mobile wallets, online banking transfers, and contactless card payments
- Neobank user counts include registered accounts; active user rates vary by region
- License counts reflect full banking licenses only, excluding e-money or payment institution licenses
- The 2020 spike in digital adoption reflects pandemic-accelerated behavioral shifts

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np

# ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
years      = list(range(2015, 2025))
years_neo  = list(range(2016, 2025))

dpp = {
    'North America': [38.2, 42.5, 47.1, 52.8, 58.3, 67.4, 73.1, 78.6, 82.9, 86.1],
    'Europe':        [35.0, 39.8, 44.2, 50.1, 56.7, 64.3, 70.8, 76.2, 80.5, 84.0],
    'Asia-Pacific':  [28.5, 35.2, 43.8, 52.6, 61.0, 71.5, 78.3, 83.7, 87.9, 91.2],
    'Latin America': [18.3, 22.1, 26.9, 32.4, 38.7, 48.2, 55.6, 62.3, 68.1, 73.5],
}
tbb = {
    'North America': [98.4,  96.1,  93.2,  89.7,  85.8,  79.3,  74.1,  68.5,  63.2,  58.6],
    'Europe':        [182.3, 176.8, 169.5, 160.2, 150.1, 137.6, 126.3, 115.8, 106.4,  98.1],
    'Asia-Pacific':  [312.5, 315.8, 314.2, 308.6, 298.4, 281.2, 263.7, 245.1, 228.3, 213.5],
    'Latin America': [87.6,  88.2,  87.9,  86.3,  83.8,  78.5,  73.9,  69.1,  64.8,  61.2],
}
neo = {
    'North America': [2.1,   5.8,  12.4,  23.7,  42.5,  68.3,  95.1, 121.8, 146.2],
    'Europe':        [3.5,   9.2,  19.8,  38.1,  65.4,  98.7, 132.5, 163.2, 189.6],
    'Asia-Pacific':  [8.3,  22.6,  51.4,  98.7, 172.3, 261.8, 348.2, 425.6, 498.3],
    'Latin America': [0.8,   2.3,   6.1,  15.8,  35.2,  62.4,  91.7, 118.3, 142.1],
}
dbl = {
    'North America': [ 2,  3,  5,  8, 12, 18, 26, 33, 39, 44],
    'Europe':        [ 4,  7, 12, 19, 28, 38, 51, 62, 71, 78],
    'Asia-Pacific':  [ 3,  5,  9, 15, 24, 37, 52, 65, 76, 85],
    'Latin America': [ 0,  1,  2,  4,  7, 12, 19, 26, 32, 37],
}

# ── Palette ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG          = '#0A1628'
PANEL_BG    = '#0F1F3D'
GRID_CLR    = '#1E3358'
TEXT_WHITE  = '#E8EEF7'
TEXT_MUTED  = '#7A9CC4'
ACCENT_RED  = '#FF4D6D'
ACCENT_GRN  = '#00D4AA'
HIGHLIGHT   = '#FFD166'

rcol = {
    'North America': '#4DA6FF',
    'Europe':        '#00E5CC',
    'Asia-Pacific':  '#FFB800',
    'Latin America': '#FF6B8A',
}

# ── Figure & Layout ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(22, 15), facecolor=BG)
fig.suptitle(
    'FINTECH DISRUPTION: DIGITAL BANKING REVOLUTION  2015 – 2024',
    fontsize=19, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_WHITE,
    y=0.975, fontfamily='DejaVu Sans'
)

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(
    2, 3,
    figure=fig,
    hspace=0.52, wspace=0.38,
    left=0.06, right=0.97, top=0.93, bottom=0.07
)

def style_ax(ax, title, xlabel='', ylabel='', ylabel2=''):
    ax.set_facecolor(PANEL_BG)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_color(GRID_CLR)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_MUTED, labelsize=9)
    ax.xaxis.label.set_color(TEXT_MUTED)
    ax.yaxis.label.set_color(TEXT_MUTED)
    ax.grid(axis='y', color=GRID_CLR, linewidth=0.6, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
    ax.grid(axis='x', color=GRID_CLR, linewidth=0.4, linestyle=':', alpha=0.5)
    ax.set_title(title, color=TEXT_WHITE, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=8)
    if xlabel:
        ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, fontsize=9)
    if ylabel:
        ax.set_ylabel(ylabel, fontsize=9)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1 (top-left, span 2 cols): Crossover Dynamics
# Dual-axis: digital payment penetration (rising) vs bank branches (declining)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
ax1_r = ax1.twinx()
style_ax(ax1,
         'Digital Rise vs. Branch Decline — The Crossover Dynamics',
         ylabel='Digital Payment Penetration (%)')

regions = list(dpp.keys())
for reg in regions:
    ax1.plot(years, dpp[reg], color=rcol[reg], linewidth=2.5,
             marker='o', markersize=4, label=f'{reg} (penetration)')
    ax1_r.plot(years, tbb[reg], color=rcol[reg], linewidth=2.0,
               linestyle='--', marker='s', markersize=3, alpha=0.75)

ax1.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax1_r.set_ylim(0, 400)
ax1.set_xticks(years)
ax1.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years], rotation=30, fontsize=8.5)
ax1.yaxis.label.set_color(ACCENT_GRN)
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=ACCENT_GRN)
ax1_r.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=ACCENT_RED, labelsize=9)
ax1_r.set_ylabel('Traditional Bank Branches (thousands)', fontsize=9,
                 color=ACCENT_RED)
ax1_r.spines['right'].set_color(GRID_CLR)
ax1_r.spines['left'].set_color(GRID_CLR)
for spine in ax1_r.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(GRID_CLR)

# Shade COVID acceleration zone
ax1.axvspan(2019, 2020, alpha=0.12, color=HIGHLIGHT, zorder=0)
ax1.text(2019.5, 93, 'COVID\nAcceleration', color=HIGHLIGHT,
         fontsize=7.5, ha='center', va='top', fontweight='bold')

# Arrow annotation showing crossover direction
ax1.annotate('', xy=(2024, 86), xytext=(2024, 72),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ACCENT_GRN, lw=2))
ax1_r.annotate('', xy=(2024, 200), xytext=(2024, 260),
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ACCENT_RED, lw=2))

# Legend
solid = [Line2D([0],[0], color=rcol[r], lw=2.5, marker='o', ms=5) for r in regions]
dash  = [Line2D([0],[0], color='white',  lw=1.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)]
labels_solid = [f'{r}' for r in regions]
legend1 = ax1.legend(
    solid + dash,
    labels_solid + ['— — Branches (right axis)'],
    loc='upper left', fontsize=8, framealpha=0.2,
    facecolor=PANEL_BG, edgecolor=GRID_CLR, labelcolor=TEXT_WHITE,
    ncol=2, handlelength=1.8
)
ax1.add_artist(legend1)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2 (top-right): Branch Closure Acceleration
# Year-on-year closures per region
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
style_ax(ax2,
         'Annual Branch Closures by Region',
         xlabel='Year', ylabel='Net Branch Change (thousands)')

# Compute YoY deltas (negative = closures)
yoy_years = list(range(2016, 2025))
x = np.arange(len(yoy_years))
width = 0.21
offsets = [-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5]
for i, reg in enumerate(regions):
    deltas = [tbb[reg][j] - tbb[reg][j-1] for j in range(1, len(tbb[reg]))]
    bars = ax2.bar(x + offsets[i]*width, deltas, width,
                   color=rcol[reg], alpha=0.85, label=reg)

# Highlight 2019→2020 with border
ax2.axvspan(3.5, 4.5, alpha=0.15, color=HIGHLIGHT, zorder=0)
ax2.text(4.0, 0.4, '2019→2020\nPeak Closures', color=HIGHLIGHT,
         fontsize=7, ha='center', fontweight='bold')
ax2.axhline(0, color=TEXT_MUTED, linewidth=0.8)
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in yoy_years], rotation=40, fontsize=8)
ax2.legend(fontsize=7.5, framealpha=0.2, facecolor=PANEL_BG,
           edgecolor=GRID_CLR, labelcolor=TEXT_WHITE, ncol=2)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 3 (bottom-left): Neobank User Surge — Stacked Area
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
style_ax(ax3,
         'Neobank User Surge by Region  (Cumulative Registered Users)',
         xlabel='Year', ylabel='Users (millions)')

# Stack in order: LatAm, NA, Europe, APAC
stack_order = ['Latin America', 'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia-Pacific']
stack_data  = np.array([neo[r] for r in stack_order])
stack_alpha = [0.70, 0.75, 0.80, 0.85]
stack_colors = [rcol[r] for r in stack_order]

ax3.stackplot(years_neo, stack_data,
              labels=stack_order,
              colors=stack_colors,
              alpha=0.78)

# Overlay individual lines for clarity
for reg in stack_order:
    ax3.plot(years_neo, neo[reg], color=rcol[reg], linewidth=0,  # invisible, for legend
             alpha=0)

ax3.set_xticks(years_neo)
ax3.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years_neo], rotation=30, fontsize=8.5)

# Annotate 2024 totals
total_2024 = sum(neo[r][-1] for r in stack_order)
ax3.annotate(f'Total 2024:\n{total_2024:.0f}M users',
             xy=(2024, total_2024), xytext=(2022.2, total_2024*0.85),
             color=TEXT_WHITE, fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=TEXT_MUTED, lw=1.2))

# APAC dominance annotation
ax3.text(2023.5, 480, 'APAC\nLeads', color=rcol['Asia-Pacific'],
         fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', ha='center')

handles3 = [mpatches.Patch(color=rcol[r], alpha=0.85, label=r) for r in stack_order]

# PANEL 2 (top-right): Branch Closure Acceleration
# Year-on-year closures per region
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
style_ax(ax2,
         'Annual Branch Closures by Region',
         xlabel='Year', ylabel='Net Branch Change (thousands)')

# Compute YoY deltas (negative = closures)
yoy_years = list(range(2016, 2025))
x = np.arange(len(yoy_years))
width = 0.21
offsets = [-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5]
for i, reg in enumerate(regions):
    deltas = [tbb[reg][j] - tbb[reg][j-1] for j in range(1, len(tbb[reg]))]
    bars = ax2.bar(x + offsets[i]*width, deltas, width,
                   color=rcol[reg], alpha=0.85, label=reg)

# Highlight 2019→2020 with border
ax2.axvspan(3.5, 4.5, alpha=0.15, color=HIGHLIGHT, zorder=0)
ax2.text(4.0, 0.4, '2019→2020\nPeak Closures', color=HIGHLIGHT,
         fontsize=7, ha='center', fontweight='bold')
ax2.axhline(0, color=TEXT_MUTED, linewidth=0.8)
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in yoy_years], rotation=40, fontsize=8)
ax2.legend(fontsize=7.5, framealpha=0.2, facecolor=PANEL_BG,
           edgecolor=GRID_CLR, labelcolor=TEXT_WHITE, ncol=2)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 3 (bottom-left): Neobank User Surge — Stacked Area
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
style_ax(ax3,
         'Neobank User Surge by Region  (Cumulative Registered Users)',
         xlabel='Year', ylabel='Users (millions)')

# Stack in order: LatAm, NA, Europe, APAC
stack_order = ['Latin America', 'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia-Pacific']
stack_data  = np.array([neo[r] for r in stack_order])
stack_alpha = [0.70, 0.75, 0.80, 0.85]
stack_colors = [rcol[r] for r in stack_order]

ax3.stackplot(years_neo, stack_data,
              labels=stack_order,
              colors=stack_colors,
              alpha=0.78)

# Overlay individual lines for clarity
for reg in stack_order:
    ax3.plot(years_neo, neo[reg], color=rcol[reg], linewidth=0,  # invisible, for legend
             alpha=0)

ax3.set_xticks(years_neo)
ax3.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years_neo], rotation=30, fontsize=8.5)

# Annotate 2024 totals
total_2024 = sum(neo[r][-1] for r in stack_order)
ax3.annotate(f'Total 2024:\n{total_2024:.0f}M users',
             xy=(2024, total_2024), xytext=(2022.2, total_2024*0.85),
             color=TEXT_WHITE, fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=TEXT_MUTED, lw=1.2))

# APAC dominance annotation
ax3.text(2023.5, 480, 'APAC\nLeads', color=rcol['Asia-Pacific'],
         fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', ha='center')

handles3 = [mpatches.Patch(color=rcol[r], alpha=0.85, label=r) for r in stack_order]
ax3.legend(handles=handles3, loc='upper left', fontsize=8.5,
           framealpha=0.2, facecolor=PANEL_BG, edgecolor=GRID_CLR,
           labelcolor=TEXT_WHITE, ncol=4)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 4 (bottom-right): Regulatory License Wave
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
style_ax(ax4,
         'Cumulative Digital Banking\nLicenses by Region',
         xlabel='Year', ylabel='Cumulative Licenses Approved')

for reg in regions:
    ax4.plot(years, dbl[reg], color=rcol[reg], linewidth=2.5,
             marker='o', markersize=5, label=reg)
    ax4.fill_between(years, dbl[reg], alpha=0.1, color=rcol[reg])

# Highlight 2019-2021 surge band
ax4.axvspan(2019, 2021, alpha=0.10, color=HIGHLIGHT)
ax4.text(2020, 88, 'License\nSurge', color=HIGHLIGHT,
         fontsize=7.5, ha='center', fontweight='bold')

ax4.set_xticks(years)
ax4.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years], rotation=40, fontsize=8)
ax4.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax4.legend(fontsize=8, framealpha=0.2, facecolor=PANEL_BG,
           edgecolor=GRID_CLR, labelcolor=TEXT_WHITE)

# ── Footer annotation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(
    0.5, 0.004,
    'Sources: Regional digital payment surveys, central bank branch registries, neobank disclosures, regulatory licensing databases  |  '
    'Branch figures in thousands; Neobank users cumulative registered accounts; License counts: full digital banking licenses only',
    ha='center', fontsize=7.2, color=TEXT_MUTED, style='italic'
)

# ── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none')
print("Saved to /app/output/result.png")
